description: This file manages the persistence and retrieval of subagent registry data, including loading from and saving to disk, handling different registry versions, and resolving file paths for storage.

methods.name: resolveSubagentStateDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory path for subagent state, considering environment variables and test modes.

methods.name: resolveSubagentRegistryPath
methods.description: Returns the full file path for the subagent registry JSON file.

methods.name: loadSubagentRegistryFromDisk
methods.description: Loads the subagent registry data from disk, handling version migration and data normalization.

methods.name: saveSubagentRegistryToDisk
methods.description: Saves the current subagent registry data to disk in JSON format.
